name: business-insights-report
description: Upload any CSV and get an automatic business report: KPIs, trends, category breakdowns, correlations, and rule-based findings, with an optional AI-written narrative. Runs entirely in the browser except the optional AI feature, which uses a server-side proxy so the API key is never exposed to clients.

scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
